handoff_rule.consumes_policy: Use contaminated Stage7 artifacts only as planning and debug evidence under contamination_barrier.0001 through contamination_barrier.0003; use Stage6 contracts as trusted baselines.
handoff_rule.evidence_rule: Do not claim pass unless evidence is bound to SACG constraints or explicitly recorded as not_run.
handoff_rule.on_reject: Return the classification for evidence completion; do not authorize a Stage7 retry, RTL edit, or removal of any contamination barrier.
ready_when: Every failed invariant is mapped to a failure class, violated constraint, causal root candidate, and bounded repair route.
The ten scaffold/semantic-testbench failures are deduplicated where they share the same weight-binding precondition cause.
Every not_run gate is labeled dependency_blocked or pending rather than misclassified as an independent implementation defect.
The causal slice distinguishes contract or harness deficiencies from demonstrated RTL numeric mismatches.

handoff_rule.consumes_policy: Inspect current generated and verification manifests as evidence; do not overwrite artifacts under active contamination barriers and do not silently substitute checkpoint or reference identities.
handoff_rule.evidence_rule: Do not claim pass unless evidence is bound to SACG constraints or explicitly recorded as not_run.
handoff_rule.on_reject: Classify the unresolved item as approval-required backtrack or unsupported repair; do not generate free-form RTL or rerun semantic verification.
ready_when: Each proposed change names an existing trusted template, parameter binding, generated manifest field, or harness contract boundary.
The plan covers accelerator_scope, checkpoint and reference hashes, all required current-scope tensor hashes, fallback prohibition, stage harness availability, and DUT weight-consumption proof.
Any absent explicit atol, rtol, or max_mismatch_fraction is classified as an upstream numeric-policy or immutable-contract gap rather than filled with an inferred value.
No proposed action changes model semantics or introduces a case-specific core not supplied by the adapter.

handoff_rule.consumes_policy: Treat retry_request.0001 as active and authoritative; do not create a duplicate retry. There is currently no open backtrack request, so any backtrack is only a proposal until accepted.
handoff_rule.evidence_rule: Do not claim pass unless evidence is bound to SACG constraints or explicitly recorded as not_run.
handoff_rule.on_reject: Keep retry_request.0001 blocked and submit no contract mutation; unresolved approval items remain explicit blockers.
ready_when: Every contract gap is classified as local repair, Stage6 contract backtrack, upstream numeric-policy backtrack, or no-action dependency block.
The missing explicit numeric comparison policy is not fabricated and is routed through the human boundary where required.
The proposed retry preconditions require semantic-testbench readiness, valid DUT binding, immutable hash agreement, and completion of selected prerequisite gates.
Any proposed backtrack cites the exact artifacts and constraints requiring revision.

handoff_rule.consumes_policy: Accept only specialist outputs that passed their declared checkers. Preserve all three active contamination barriers until a new checker-verified transition explicitly supersedes them.
handoff_rule.evidence_rule: Do not claim pass unless evidence is bound to SACG constraints or explicitly recorded as not_run.
handoff_rule.on_accept: Issue only the allowed bounded repair actions; if approval or contract revision is required, materialize the proposed stage_backtrack_request before any Stage7 retry. After approved repair, route only targeted prerequisite checkers and selected Stage7 gates.
handoff_rule.on_reject: Keep retry_request.0001 open and blocked, preserve contamination barriers, and return conflicting or unsupported actions to the responsible specialist.
ready_when: Every action cites causal evidence, affected artifacts, violated constraints, allowed edit boundaries, required checker reruns, and rollback behavior.
Template-bounded loader, manifest, or harness actions are separated from numeric-policy and immutable-contract changes.
Any missing tolerance or semantic identity change is routed to explicit human approval and backtrack rather than silently repaired.
The existing Stage7 retry is released only after all declared repair and contract preconditions pass.
No contaminated Stage7 artifact is handed off as a validated design input.
